faq.title: FAQ

data.a: Conversations and files live in our own database + container volumes, encrypted in transit. Only you can read them; admins see aggregate usage, never content.

choose.q: How do I pick a model?
choose.a: Long-form Chinese / heavy reasoning → GPT-5.4 / 5.5. Quick replies → GPT-5.4-mini or Grok-4 fast. Long-doc summaries → Kimi (huge context). Code & math → DeepSeek (best value). Switch anytime per chat.

topup.a: Enter a redemption code on /purchase. During the early-access phase admins issue codes manually; payment integration is on the roadmap.

api.a: Yes. Generate sk-tokens on /keys and call OpenAI-compatible endpoints — /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/images/generations, …

web.a: OpenAI Responses API's built-in web_search tool — public web, with clickable source links in the response.

image.a: Per OpenAI's terms, you (the user) own image-generation outputs. Check the upstream license before commercial reuse.
